title: Personal Loans Refinance Pricing Memo: Payment-Record Credit on the Refinance Fee
content:
## Rule

A payment-record credit comes off the refinance fee percent of a Personal Loans refinance application, where the installment payments counted are the payments of type scheduled installment posted on the loan being refinanced less one for every payment returned on it, whatever it was for: 12 or more counted installment payments with no late fee charged on the loan fewer than 24 whole months (whole calendar months being the difference in calendar months, less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's) before the application date earn 0.5 point; 6 to 11 counted installment payments with no such late fee earn 0.25 point; any other loan earns no payment-record credit.

| Counted installment payments | Late fee on the loan fewer than 24 whole months before | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 12 or more | none | 0.50 point |
| 6 to 11 | none | 0.25 point |
| any | one or more | none |
| 5 or fewer | none | none |

The refinance fee percent, with this credit taken off, never goes below zero.

## Counting (hypothetical records, application on 10 October)

- 14 scheduled-installment payments posted and 2 payments returned (one an additional-principal payment): 12 counted payments; no late fee since 10 October two years earlier: 0.50 point.
- The same record with a late fee charged on 11 October two years earlier: 23 whole months before, so the credit is none.
- The same record with the late fee charged on 10 October two years earlier instead: 24 whole months before, not fewer than 24, so it does not stand in the way: 0.50 point.
- 9 scheduled-installment payments, none returned, no late fee: 0.25 point.
